summary: Tested Human Coach Review feature for ChessGuru. All backend API tests (13/13) passed. Frontend UI tests verified all 5 sections render correctly, moment cards are clickable and navigate the board, and view toggle between Coach/Decrypt works properly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: GET /api/lab/{game_id}/coach-review returns all 5 sections (story, mirror, moments, takeaway, proof) correctly
Backend: story section has opening/tension/climax/resolution/arc_type fields as specified
Backend: mirror section has observation and pattern_insight fields for personality insights
Backend: moments section returns 2-3 critical moments with thinking_error object (type, label, description, root_cause)
Backend: takeaway section has mantra field with meaningful coaching advice
Backend: proof section has improvements/still_working_on/message fields for progress tracking
Backend: LLM narrative layer (llm_narrative) generates story_narrative, mirror_narrative, moment_insights, takeaway_refined, encouragement
Frontend: Coach view button (data-testid='coach-view-btn') toggles to show CoachReview component
Frontend: All 5 sections render with proper styling and data-testid attributes
Frontend: Moment cards are clickable and navigate the board to the correct position with arrows
Frontend: Decrypt view works normally after switching back (data-testid='decrypt-view-btn')
Frontend: View toggle requires ~5-6 seconds for data to load due to LLM call
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test game ID: test_game_a793ed92
context_for_next_testing_agent: Human Coach Review feature fully tested. Key findings: (1) GET /api/lab/{game_id}/coach-review returns 5 sections (story, mirror, moments, takeaway, proof), (2) LLM narrative layer provides human-readable coaching language, (3) Moment cards navigate board with arrows (green=best move, red=user's move), (4) View toggle between Coach/Decrypt works but needs ~5-6s wait for LLM response. Dev login: GET /api/auth/dev-login. Test game: test_game_a793ed92. Coach view: data-testid='coach-view-btn'.

response_structure.story: opening, tension, climax, resolution, arc_type, opponent, opening_name, user_won, is_draw
response_structure.mirror: observation, pattern_insight, pattern_count, total_games, style, strength, weakness
response_structure.moments: Array of 0-3 critical moments with move_number, move_san, best_move, cp_loss, phase, thinking_error
response_structure.proof: has_enough_data, message, improvements[], still_working_on[], recent_accuracy, older_accuracy
response_structure.diagnosis: Game diagnosis type (e.g., MATE_BLIND, THROW, etc.)
